title: Useful app
body: Very useful app in tracking ur desired behaviors to reach ur goals. Will be best if app allows u to color code different behaviors as part of different areas eg relationships or health, so it's clearly seen, and also sync across devices real time (currently it's based on drop box). Users may want to limit certain activities to particular days eg volunteer on a Saturday- if so perhaps the Saturday box should be coloured differently from the other days as a reminder, with the other days greyed out - otherwise it appears that the user is slacking off on the other days when in reality it's planned out
